correctness.rationale: For a<=b<=c positive theta-graph branch lengths and normalized arclength sampling, separate same-path pair-distance tails from different-path planar polygon tails. Same-path long-arm rerouting generates jump -2(u-m)/L^2 at (u+m)/2, and the vanishing width of the cross-path x+y strip generates -4 min(u,v,w)/L^2. Summing produces precisely three labeled negative jumps: -2(a+b)/L^2 at (a+b)/2, -2(a+c)/L^2 at (a+c)/2, and -4a/L^2 at (b+c)/2; they add at repeated locations without cancellation. Density f(0+)=2/L and the jump-location pattern recover the three lengths for distinct, two-tied and all-equal cases. Independently implemented exact rational polygon clipping and same-path integrals for nine positive triples including every tie pattern and verified each jump and normalization. This is a finite check; the all-real proof uses the geometric strip and endpoint argument.
